answer_1.quote: Language models are increasingly being used as tool-using agents, where they can generate executable API calls ... We evaluate MICE on STE's test set of 750 examples. In all cases, we label a generated tool call as correct if and only if it exactly matches the one given by STE.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate MICE on STE's test set... We use smooth Expected Calibration Error (smECE) and Expected Tool-Calling Utility (ETCU) as metrics, and also report Area Under Curve (AUC) of the ETCU curve.
